lines.en: : Cut! Cut! Niki, for the last time, the line is “...and that’s why I always trust Morning Gold.” Not “that’s why I trust no one but myself.”
: I think she used a lot more expletives than that, Sir.
: I know what the fucking line is! But when the fucking lighting crew can’t get their shit together and keeps shining fucking beams in my eyes, of course I’m going to get the line wrong!
: Ugh. Fine. Can we get lighting adjusted so the princess stops complaining?
: Patrice! Shoot him!
: I’m not sure that’s legal, Niki.
: Please, just do it anyway. I am literally begging you.
: Reset on lighting, please! Positions! We still have to shoot the English version next, so let’s get it on this take!
: Morning Gold, Japanese — take 57.
: Hah. Action!
: And that’s why I always trust Morning Gold.
: Whether I’m preparing for a show or relaxing at home, I can always count on it leaving my skin feeling fresh and rejuvenated and also not fucking cheating on me like my stupid ex-boyfriend.
: Cut! Please tell me we can fix that in post. Please.
: We might be able to salvage something, but she didn’t really take a breath there. Can we get one more just to be safe?
: Can you jump off a fucking bridge? We were supposed to be done an hour ago and if I have to hold this smile for one more second I am going to kill every last one of you.
: Niki, can you-
: Fuck off, Patrice! Get back in the cage!
: Jesus, Niki. I just wanted to tell you your sister’s here.
: Oh, yay. What a pleasant surprise. Why?
: I need a fucking cigarette. Take five! And I mean fucking five, people!
: Hey. Sorry to bother you while you’re crashing out on camera, but you’ve been avoiding me everywhere else and it’s left me no choice but to corner you like this.
: How did you even find me? I blocked you on literally everything and reaching out to me under those circumstances is in clear violation of section 9A of Nakayama Sister Law.
: You forgot to block me on Skype, so I’d only be violating 9C at best.
: Bullshit! Nobody fucking uses Skype anymore! The fact remains that I don’t want to talk to you and now you’re here, ruining everything again!
: You sure about that, Nee-chan? Cause it seemed to me like you were in the process of ruining everything yourself by ranting about Akira in front of the cameras.
: They’ll fix it in post! I don’t have a therapist and this is the only fucking place I can rant! So fuck off if you’ve got a problem with that.
: Just rant to me. I’m still your-
: You?! You expect me to trust you with literally anything after what you did?! You’re lucky I haven’t told our parents about what happened.
: Please, can we just talk? It’s about Akira.
: Well, no fucking shit! Can it not wait until I’m done fucking shooting, though?!
: I’ve been here since the fortieth take. This shoot might literally never end based on everything I’ve seen so far.
: I will give you four fucking minutes and that’s it. And every single one of those minutes better be spent apologizing to me or I will kill you too.

: Fine...deal. Can we go off to the side though so I don’t have to talk about my sex life in front of a bunch of strangers? Assuming you didn’t already tell them everything in the first thirty-nine takes.
: Three minutes and fifty-five seconds.
Let’s stop the clock for a moment and talk about how we got here. How, in this world so full of fish, these two brightly colored anglers managed to hook the same one.
With the same rod, even, given that it became a hand-me-down after the older sister swapped to a net out of desperation, just to wave it around underwater and catch more than she bargained for.
Fish analogies aside, though, this was and forever would be the steepest hill these two will ever have to cross. So steep, in fact, that Niki was now contemplating just pushing Noriko down it.
The spiteful part of her, which was the largest part of all these days, scorned her sister at the moment.
For what had happened this time could not be misconstrued or interpreted as the unwelcome raiding of a closet, but the blatant arson of everything Niki had ever wanted.
And to think that this fire was still blazing just beyond the horizon was infuriating. Her sister still reeked of the smoke.
Could she really expect to hear an apology when extinguishing the flames hadn’t even crossed her mind?
And even if she did, would it make her feel any better? Would the weight on her shoulders be lifted, or merely replaced with ashes that she’d struggle to relocate after swiping them from her clothes?
Stronger than all of that, though, was the disbelief. It was thinking something like this would never actually happen since they were so far apart in age.
And yet it did.
And yet she saw it.
And yet it was burned into her mind.
: I’m sorry.
: If I knew that was going to happen, I never would have come to the beach at all.
: Yeah, you seemed really fucking remorseful while you were having sex with him. Thanks, Noriko.
: You wanted it to happen. You’re not sorry at all.
: Of course I wanted it to happen. That doesn’t mean I’m not sorry, though.
: But really...I had no idea. It just...
: One thing led to another and...all of that led to this.
: Now, things are never going to be the same and we’ll always find it a little harder to look each other in the eye. We’re still sisters, though.
: Unfortunately, yes. We are.
: Unfortunately, huh?

: If it’s any consolation, I’m more pissed off at Akira than I am at you. You’re just a fucking...stupid, hormonal teenager who finally got to fulfill a fucking gross fantasy of hers. So congrats, I guess.
: Let’s be real, Nee-chan. We’d be in the same exact place if this happened a few years from now. My age isn’t as important as you’re pretending it is.
: No, maybe it isn’t. But the fact that he literally watched you grow up is. What kind of sick fuck can do that to a girl who used to sit on his lap when she was a baby?
: The same guy who used to leave our house and then go get molested by an older woman.
: Let’s not pretend Akira’s sex life has ever been pure and good, Nee-chan. Chances are you weren’t even the first girl he actually did anything with.
: First off, I don’t know why you know about that, but I’d prefer if you didn’t just casually bring it up even if you think it’s somehow relevant.
: Which, second, it’s not. Terrible things happening to Akira does not give him an excuse to do terrible things to you or...anyone else since it’s apparently not just you either.
: He’d say the same thing. It’s not like he thinks he’s a saint. He’s just a profoundly broken man who only knows one way to show his affection since that’s all he was ever taught.
: I don’t want it to sound like I’m making excuses for him, though. What you and Sensei have is different than what he has with anybody else. Even me. And he should have put you first.
: So let’s just forget about who he’s cheating on you with and just the fact that he’s cheating on you at all.
: Stop emphasizing “cheating” like that. It’s not just my interpretation of what happened. It is what happened.
: Nee-chan...you really thought you were the only one?
: Yes! I did! Does that really make me that fucking crazy?! Was I wrong for thinking he loved me even half as much as I love him?!
: We lived together and everything...I thought we were going to get married one day.
: You’ve thought that since you were a kid.
: I have! Which is why this hurts so fucking much! Both of you have ripped my fucking heart out, and you didn’t even care enough to stop when I caught you doing it!
: How am I ever supposed to forgive you guys for that?...
: I don’t want your forgiveness. And I don’t think Akira does either. I think we both want to feel hated by you since anything else would just make you look weak.
: Which you’re not, Nee-chan. You’re an idiot, sure. But you’re stronger than anyone I’ve ever met and I know you’re going to get through this somehow too.
: Maybe...but then what? What comes next? Because I can tell myself I can live without him over and over and over again but we both know I can’t. I’ve already proven that.
: You don’t have to live without him. You can do what I’m doing and just-
: What, share him? You’re seriously okay with that? It doesn’t gross you the fuck out and make you want to punch him in his stupid fucking idiot face?
: You seem to forget that this is what I’ve expected from the beginning. He’s never going to be mine so long as you exist. But even sharing him was always just a dream until recently.
: That said, though, don’t expect me to back off just because you don’t like it.
: I’m not going anywhere so long as he lets me near his side. And if you want to disown me for that, I understand.
: And it’s not just because I’m in love with him either. It’s because he needs me. He needs us.
: He doesn’t fucking need us. That’s why he left us. And we’re both idiots for chasing him down and expecting to be able to fix him.
: If that’s what you believe, fine. You’re wrong, though.
: He left us because he needs us. And that’s the single most selfless thing he’s ever done.
: Well, it’s not like it’s a long fucking list even if that is true. I can’t suffer anymore, though. If you want to, fine. But I’ve been suffering longer than you’ve been alive and this is just...
: It’s too much now. It all hurts too much.
: You say that, but if he stormed in this room right now and begged for you to come back, you’d fold without a second thought.
: That’s what you did when I brought him here the first time after all.
: Years and years of “I’m gonna get famous just to piss him off” all destroyed in a matter of seconds. And all it took was one encounter.
: That was before I watched him fuck my sister. When his greatest betrayal was just leaving me behind.
: And this really hurts more than that?
: Would you be happier if he was just...gone again? Because that’s what you’re saying, isn’t it?
: I think your four minutes is up, Noriko. Please don’t go out of your way to find me again.
: Nee-chan...you need to talk to him.
: He can talk to me if he wants to talk. But he better be ready to get on his fucking knees and kiss my feet if he does.
: And even then, I’ll make sure he spends the rest of his life apologizing to me. Every minute of every day because I won’t believe him otherwise.
: You won’t believe him then either. You’ll never believe him again and that’s just the way things are going to be from now on.
: But you know they aren’t over. You know it doesn’t end like this.
: Then how does it end?
: How many more times will I let that douchebag tear me into a million fucking pieces before I can go away for good?
: You can go away for good whenever you want. The problem is you don’t want to. And, despite what you say, you still believe you can fix things deep down.
: Sorry, but you’re the one trying to get me to fix things right now when I’ve been perfectly complacent handling everything on my own.
: Perfectly complacent? Really? You threatened to kill the director like...ten minutes ago.
: Joke’s on you. I always threaten to kill that piece of shit. And I’m about one minute away from threatening to kill you too if you don’t fucking leave me alone, Noriko.
: You already did. Just before we sat down.
: Yet, you are still living. There are limits to my mercy, sister.
: Nee-chan, what would it take to start repairing things with you and Akira? Because he’s not happy either.
: Oh? Did he tell you that while he was on top of you?
: No. But unlike you, I don’t need him to tell me something to understand it. I just do because that’s the role I’ve decided to fill for him.
: You have a role to fill too, though. And it’s one I’ll never be able to sub in for no matter how hard I try. So please, just...do both of you a favor and stop this silent treatment already.
: Noriko, are you asking me to return to a relationship in which my boyfriend is actively having sex with my little sister?
: I mean...yeah. It sounds crazy when you put it that way. But, let’s be real, not a single one of us is all that sane. And I obviously don’t mind sharing with you.

: Well, you should. Because even if I hate your fucking guts right now, you are still my sister. And I don’t want you to settle for less than you deserve just because you inherited my attachment issues.
: Find someone who will love you and only you. That’s an order. Because if you ever have to go through what I am going through right now, I will find the culprit and kill them too.
: You’re feeling really murderous lately, aren’t you?
: You have no fucking idea.
: Can you promise me one thing, at least?
: Probably not, but say it anyway.
: If I can get Sensei to come talk to you, will you at least hear him out? Or will you explode into a bawling mess the second you see his face?
: My answer hinges entirely on how many sharp objects are nearby when he approaches me.
: Be serious, please. I want us to go back to normal. Even if I need to orchestrate some sort of grand romantic gesture in order for it to happen.
: Akira? Grand romantic gesture? Come on. Let’s be real.
: Well, yeah. That’s why I said I’d orchestrate it.
: Fine. If you can orchestrate some sort of grand gesture in which he grovels and begs for my forgiveness, I will consider hearing him out. It needs to be grand though.
: The whole world must know that he is submitting to me and that he will do everything I say for the rest of eternity.
: So...you want him to become your slave.
: That sounds about right. Yes.
: Okay, people! Break time’s over! Niki, you’re needed back on set! And hopefully less mad!
: Hah...guess that’s that then.
: Can you unblock me on Instagram at least? I keep trying to send you memes and then forgetting you hate me now.
: I’ll think about it. Now, get lost. I still have work to do. And try not to fuck anyone’s boyfriend on the way out.
: Will do, Nee-chan. Will do.
: Hah...
: So you’re using her as a messenger now, Akira?
: Was it not enough to break my heart in person? You have to deliver the torment directly to me now?
: Some childhood friend you are...
: And some sucker I am for sitting here expecting you to do anything about it.
: Heh...I’m even talking to myself now.
: Look what you’ve done to me...
: I hope you’re suffering too...wherever you are right now.
: Niki! Again! We need you on set! The world does not revolve around you, contrary to what your followers may make you believe!
: I know...
: Just give me one more minute, please...
: Hah...Sorry. I’ve done all I can.
: Don’t worry about it. We only have a few more shoots left after this one anyway.
: She’s still planning on going on hiatus? That’s not just a rumor?
: Well, I’m not 100%% sure, but word around the industry is that 567 has already started planning her retirement tour.
: Tour? But wouldn’t that mean-
: Woah! Who the fuck are you?! How did you get in here?!
: Niki Nakayama.
: I have come here to grovel and kiss your feet.
: Oh, you’ve gotta be fucking kidding me.
